  "rationale": "The core of the augmentation—mentioned_attributes plus the per-attribute one-hot flags—is well-targeted to the query, giving clean grouping axes to relate specific product attributes to satisfaction Scores, and the values are sound readings of the source text. attribute_count is a reasonable derived helper.
